title: Typed graph (input to the shared graph viewer)
description: What a project hands graph-viewer: typed nodes, labelled directed edges, and how each kind looks. The viewer owns layout, rendering, fit-then-zoom and selection; the project owns meaning.

kinds.description: Display settings per node kind. A kind with no entry gets a neutral look.

label.description: Plain name shown on the node, e.g. 'System'.

dashed.description: Dashed outline, e.g. for modeled rather than stated items.

explain.description: One sentence shown when a reader asks what this kind is.

plural.description: Plural name used in counts, e.g. 'Systems' (default: label).

collapsed.description: Nodes of this kind start closed: their children are hidden and counted on the node (lanes layout).

explain.description: One plain sentence shown as the node's tooltip on hover, keyboard focus or tap; overrides its kind's explain.

parent.description: Id of the node that contains this one (lanes layout draws it indented under its parent; a closed parent hides it and counts it).

collapsed.description: Start closed; overrides the kind's collapsed.

lane.description: Lane id (layout.lanes) for a top-level node; children inherit their parent's lane. Nodes with no lane go to the shared lane.

order.description: Position among its siblings (document order). Default: order in the nodes array.

details.description: Rows shown in the details panel when the node is selected: [label, value] pairs.

source.description: Exact source text shown in the details panel, with [start, end) highlighted. 'from' reuses another node's source text so long passages are stored once.

quiet.description: Drawn only while one of its ends (or the edge) is selected: keeps many-to-many links from hiding the page.

algorithm.description: layered (default) for flows and chains; force for hub graphs where many facts share participants. lanes for several ordered documents side by side: one column per lane, each top-level node's children listed under it in order (an outline), closed nodes count what they hide.

lanes.description: Columns for the lanes layout, left to right.

sharedLane.description: The lane for nodes with no lane (for example people who appear in several documents).

nodeWidth.description: Box width in the lanes layout (default 250).

hyperedges.description: Facts that join several nodes in named roles (keep-n-ary-relations-whole). Each is drawn as one hub node with a role-labelled spoke to every participant, never split into pairs.
